stem.text: What explains the difference in the partial pressures of oxygen in the pulmonary artery and pulmonary vein?

A.text: Oxygen diffuses from the alveoli into the blood in the capillaries.

B.text: Carbon dioxide diffuses into the alveoli from the blood in the capillaries.

C.text: Oxygen diffuses from the body cells into the blood in the capillaries.

D.text: Carbon dioxide diffuses into the body cells from the blood in the capillaries.
